rows.summary: A font face that failed and is fetched again, arriving after its build stopped waiting (3 s), now makes the preview build again at once: prepareFonts marks the attempts it stopped waiting for, a late one's arrival calls fontFallback.js's faceFetched, the PDF worker relays it ({ faceFetched }), pdfBuild passes it on and PdfPreview rebuilds. Before, the stand-in face (a bold printed as the regular) stayed until the next edit. Also pinned now: arrived data goes in only at build time, right before priming; an 'online' while a fetch is on its way starts no second one (8624425).

issues: The worker's relay line had no test — added (a stand-in worker scope).
faceFetched's listener loop could stop at a throwing listener — each is now called on its own.
Two tests slept 50 ms for the late face — they now wait for the signal.
CI then showed a font's two bold faces (normal, italic) each signal: one extra preview build at most, accepted; the test allows one per late face.
